instruction: Facing the mirror on the wall, turn 180 degrees and go through the right doorway into the bedroom. In the bedroom, turn to your right you'll see a chair and in the distance a couch. Jump over the chair towards the couch. Once you're standing at the couch, facing the large plant, turn to your right and jump over the other chair, exiting with the doorway to the right of the sailboat painting. Continue straight through the open door into the hallway with the dark wooden floors. Continue to the end of the hallway. At the end of the hallway, hang a left. Now you're facing another hallway, to the right is a kitchen, take the left doorway into the dining room. Take one step onto the rug that the dining room table sits on, to the left of the chair at the head of the table. Now turn to your right and walk around the  table, going back around the chair at the head of the table, towards the fireplace. Continue walking around the table, fireplace on the right, table on the left. Keep walking till you're at the opposite corner of the table and now you should be facing outside is a window with a tree directly in your vision and then behind you will be the dining room table. You're done.
